We have a couple of constraints: IT can only enable the CORS/dev access outside of 8am–6pm ET due to maintenance windows, so evenings or weekend slots may be necessary.

Can we look at these options from your side?
- Friday 8:00 PM–9:30 PM ET (after IT window)

- Sunday 8:00 PM–9:30 PM ET

Thanks for understanding — Emma
